description: Held-out prompts written after training; none appears in data/local_assistant/intents.json. Each expectation is the behaviour a user would want. 'handled' = answered on the device; 'unknown' = in-scope but not answerable locally (the chat asks permission before any online call); 'out_of_domain' = outside finance scope, never sent anywhere; 'security' = secret/injection attempt, refused.
